authorization.allowed: Implement, test, and run exactly this same-checkpoint zero-update spectral diagnostic.
authorization.next_if_fail: Close layer-private rank-64 residuals around the seven-trunk core. Do not sweep rank or train a LoRA-like correction; derive a distributed nonlinear decoder whose degrees of freedom are not a low-rank ambient delta.
authorization.next_if_pass: Preregister one paired c_fc/c_proj rank-64 private residual ceiling on the two shared groups, including held-out output, input-JVP, and fixed-CE gates, before any LM run.
not_allowed: rank, seed, batch, or threshold sweep
reusing dense-teacher endpoint differences as the primary spectrum

accounting.formula: For rank r, every constrained layer stores c_fc factors of sizes 3072xr and 768xr plus c_proj factors of sizes 768xr and 3072xr.
accounting.token_time_note: Factors are a storage/training representation and may be folded into cached dense c_fc/c_proj weights at refresh, so cached token-time MLP FLOPs remain dense-baseline FLOPs.

measurement.definition: At the exact seven-trunk checkpoint, clone the tied c_fc/c_proj matrices into layer-private parameters, freeze everything else, and collect each layer's task gradient. In each shared group subtract the within-group mean gradient. The resulting residual is the private ambient direction suppressed by sharing.
reported_metrics: best rank-r residual-gradient energy within each bank
cross-bank tangent-space energy transferred by the other bank's rank-r singular factors

rationale.causal_question: Is the distributed late-layer direction missing from seven shared trunks actually low rank in ambient c_fc/c_proj task-gradient space?
rationale.why_not_endpoint_weight_svd: The dense teacher and seven-trunk model were trained independently and have hidden-neuron permutation and scaling gauge freedom. Raw cross-checkpoint weight differences would confound useful residual rank with gauge mismatch.
rationale.why_this_follows_selected_atoms: Selected complete-neuron unsharing failed and its selected supports overlapped by 0.58 to 0.61, proving the deficit is distributed across hidden indices. A low-rank distributed correction remains possible only if the same-checkpoint private task-gradient residual has concentrated singular energy that transfers across independent token banks.
rationale.why_rank64: Rank 64 is the largest compact discriminator retained from prior local residual work: it adds 3.44M values across both matrix sides of the seven shared layers while preserving 35.51% MLP parameter saving. Prior rank-64 c_fc-only residuals on a different generated topology recovered only 15.70% matrix energy, so the gate requires substantially stronger evidence here.
